title: Subcontractor work lacks acceptance evidence
trigger: An authorized operator accepts a relevant request or scheduled obligation into the shared workflow.
preconditions: Send a concise work order with scope, escalation contact and evidence requirements; separate technical completion from customer acceptance.
Verify customer-specific permissions, identities, rules and system integration support.

business_rules.statement: Partners can access only assigned jobs.
business_rules.rationale: Delegated work lacks explicit scope, authority, milestones and a completion contract.

acceptance_scenarios.scenario_and_expected_result: A branch employee cannot approve head-office-only expenditure.
One partner cannot view another partner’s jobs.
Missing evidence creates follow-up rather than fabricated completion.

human_review: Partner access, payout terms and required evidence must be agreed contractually.

capability_boundary.proposed_extension: External partner access and spend authorization need separate engineering.
capability_boundary.pricing: No price assigned; current rate card must not be extended by analogy.
